type_t_port_c16_compilation.md.title: Type-T port cores: static short-cycle compilation
type_t_port_c16_compilation.md.summary: For the fixed representative (j,a,c)=(4,28,4), the complete static C4/C8 layer has been compiled and independently checked. The C16 compiler replaces completion-by-completion cycle discovery with an AllSAT projection of every simple 16-cycle in a universal gadget graph.
